text:
First, convert 28 weeks and 5 days to days:  
28 weeks × 7 days/week = 196 days  
196 + 5 = 201 days before 1909-09-05.

Subtract 201 days from 1909-09-05:  
September has 5 days back → August 31, 1909.  
Remaining days: 201 − 5 = 196 days earlier.  
August 31 minus 196 days:  
August has 31 days, July 31, June 30, May 31, April 30, March 31, February 28 (1909 not leap year), January 31.  
Count backward:  
Aug: 31 days → back to Aug 0 = July 31 (196 left)  
July 31 → July 0 = June 30 (196−31=165 left)  
June 30 → June 0 = May 31 (165−30=135 left)  
May 31 → May 0 = April 30 (135−31=104 left)  
April 30 → April 0 = March 31 (104−30=74 left)  
March 31 → March 0 = Feb 28 (74−31=43 left)  
Feb 28 → Feb 0 = Jan 31 (43−28=15 left)  
Jan 31 minus 15 days = Jan 16.

FINAL_ANSWER: 1909-01-16
